Olympian Jeff Galloway offers an
easy and time-efficient system to train
for, and subsequently complete, a
5K or 10K race. Successful schedules
help beginners finish each workout
strong and pace the race for fun and
accomplishment, while recovering
fast. Time-goal runners are shown a
simple way to choose a realistic
goals with reality checks leading to
race day along with daily workouts.
Easy-to-read advice is provided on
medical check-ups, nutrition, fat-
burning, aches and pains, shoes,
motivation and much more.
